# Awesome LibreCourseUY

A curated list of open source projects built by Uruguayan developers.

84 projects and counting. Every entry is a JSON file in [`entries/`](entries/)
or [`orgs/`](orgs/), validated by CI. Want to add yours? Read
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md); you never edit this README by hand.

Being listed is not an endorsement, and it does not make a project a
LibreCourseUY project. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#what-listing-means)
explains what listing means and when an entry is removed.

## Orgs

<!-- ORGS:START -->
- [LibreCourseUY](https://librecourse.uy/): Non-profit FOSS community growing the next generation of open source contributors in Latin America.
- [Benav Labs](https://benav.io/): Transforming ideas into world class solutions.
- [DBWarden](https://dbwarden.org/): Home of DBWarden, a declarative database migration system for Python/SQLAlchemy.
- [Keel Linux](https://keel-linux.github.io/): Declarative, layered, IPv6-first system-container appliances, compatible with TurnKey Linux appliances.
<!-- ORGS:END -->

## Projects

<!-- PROJECTS:START -->
### Web

- [Easy Calendar](https://github.com/LibreCourseUY/easy-calendar): A lightweight year-view calendar web app built with Preact and Vite. Load your events via a JSON environment variable and view them month by month. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [libreblog](https://github.com/LibreCourseUY/libreblog): Blog for LibreCourseUY built with Hugo and auto-deployed via GitHub Actions.
- [mapcreator](https://mapcreator.emiliano-go.com/): Interactive multi-floor building map editor with A* pathfinding. Paint tile-based floor plans, define vertical connections and visualize shortest paths across floors. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [open-groups](https://github.com/LibreCourseUY/open-groups): Small self-hosted directory for groups, with configurable branding.
- [Portfolio](https://github.com/emiliano-go/emiliano-gandini-outeda.github.io): Personal portfolio website. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [Takeoff Performance Calculator - Pipistrel ALPHA Trainer](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/takeoff-performance-calculator-piat): Educational browser-based takeoff performance calculator for the Pipistrel ALPHA Trainer, with wind corrections and runway comparisons. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
- [TrustSight Feed](https://watcher.trustsight.org/): Searchable feed of TrustSight AUR watcher alerts. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [TrustSight Web](https://github.com/emiliano-go/trustsight-web): Single-page site presenting TrustSight's evidence-first AUR review model: capabilities, calibration, configuration and limits. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [urumap](https://github.com/LibreCourseUY/urumap): Interactive maps of Uruguayan public buildings, rendered from mapcreator JSON.
- [Weight and Balance Calculator - Pipistrel ALPHA Trainer](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/weight-and-balance-calculator-piat): Educational browser-based weight and balance calculator for the Pipistrel ALPHA Trainer, with fuel burn and center-of-gravity checks. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))

### APIs

- [audit-log-microservice](https://github.com/LibreCourseUY/audit-log-microservice): Microservice for centralized audit logging.
- [UruAPI](https://github.com/LibreCourseUY/UruAPI): API wrapping datosuruguay.com with programmatic access to Uruguay's daily economic indicators from official sources.

### Desktop

- [postal](https://github.com/emiliano-go/postal): A standalone native WhatsApp client that speaks the multi-device protocol directly: no webview, and history sync is a choice rather than a download. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [quick-bitwarden](https://github.com/Kevin-Ramirez127/quick-bitwarden): A quick way to copy your Bitwarden passwords, with a fast r-modals picker. ([@Kevin-Ramirez127](https://github.com/Kevin-Ramirez127))
- [sway-workstation](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/sway-workstation): Reproducible Arch Linux workstation setup with Sway, Waybar, Stow-managed dotfiles and hardware detection. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))

### CLI Tools

- [cedulauy-mrz-scan](https://github.com/nicolasgutierrezdev/cedulauy-mrz-scan): Scan and parse the Machine Readable Zone (MRZ) of Uruguayan identity cards from photos or a live webcam feed. ([@nicolasgutierrezdev](https://github.com/nicolasgutierrezdev))
- [checkcorruptedimages](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/checkcorruptedimages): Detect corrupted images by fully decoding them with Pillow in crash-isolated worker processes. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
- [deblotch](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/deblotch): Python API and CLI for removing color blotches and unwanted gradients from flat illustrations while preserving edges. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
- [detrack](https://github.com/emiliano-go/detrack): Strip tracking parameters from URLs. Deterministically. Zero dependencies. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [neurafly](https://github.com/emiliano-go/neurafly): Real-time audio visualizer TUI: listens to whatever your PC is playing and renders neurons firing. No samples, no playback tricks. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [smclipy](https://pypi.org/project/smclipy/): A Python script designed to streamline downloading, tagging, and organizing music from YouTube and SoundCloud. It allows you to batch-download audio, manually set metadata (including multiple artists, album, and cover art). ([@joaquinlarroca](https://github.com/joaquinlarroca))
- [sqlitexplorer](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/sqlitexplorer): CLI for exploring SQLite databases, inspecting schemas, querying and charting data, and importing or exporting records. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
- [worldclock-tty](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/worldclock-tty): Terminal-based world clock that displays multiple time zones in real time. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
- [zsh-classic-stack](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/zsh-classic-stack): Diagnose and configure a Zsh terminal stack or migrate from Oh My Zsh and Powerlevel10k to a complete shell profile. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))

### Browser Extensions

- [moodleTweaks](https://github.com/LibreCourseUY/moodleTweaks): Extensión de navegador que unifica el estilo visual de Moodle con modo oscuro automático, escala tipográfica y barra de próximas entregas.

### Libraries

- [acrresolv](https://github.com/emiliano-go/acrresolv): Hybrid acronym resolver: rules + lookup + ML. 95.5% accuracy on unseen data, <1ms inference. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [easeo](https://easeo.emiliano-go.com/): Deterministic SEO metadata library for content platforms: canonical URLs, titles, robots, Open Graph, Twitter Cards and JSON-LD from content entities. One Rust core with Python, Node.js and Rust APIs. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [gencedula](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/gencedula): Generate checksum-valid Uruguayan identity document numbers and verify their check digits. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
- [ifpeek](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/ifpeek): Inspect Linux network interfaces, Wi-Fi state, routes, DNS and network events from Python. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
- [lambda-compiler](https://github.com/emiliano-go/lambda-compiler): Compile Python lambdas into declarative filter specs via bytecode analysis. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [LLM Pydantic Tools](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/llm-pydantic-tools): Convert Pydantic models and JSON schemas into function-calling tools for OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini, with argument validation. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
- [outfancy](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/outfancy): Python library for rendering formatted tables and line charts in the terminal. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
- [parse-broken-json](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/parse-broken-json): Recover malformed or truncated JSON, including streamed LLM output, with explicit reporting of repairs. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
- [plotilleresample](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/plotilleresample): Resample datasets for Plotille terminal plots using stride, min/max, LTTB and MinMaxLTTB strategies. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
- [r-modals](https://github.com/Kevin-Ramirez127/r-modals): Instant modals for Rust - one call pops a centered, borderless, searchable option picker (eframe/egui, X11 + Wayland). ([@Kevin-Ramirez127](https://github.com/Kevin-Ramirez127))
- [react-components](https://github.com/LibreCourseUY/react-components): Collaborative React component library for developers taking their first steps in React.
- [rsyscall-ng](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/rsyscall-ng): Modernized rsyscall for controlling local and remote Linux processes from Python, with a Rust native implementation. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
- [schemap](https://schemap.emiliano-go.com/): Automatic Pydantic schemas for SQLAlchemy models. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [simple-nfc-tag](https://github.com/nicolasgutierrezdev/simple-nfc-tag): A tag-agnostic NFC data storage library built on PC/SC, abstracting away reader, tag and protocol details. ([@nicolasgutierrezdev](https://github.com/nicolasgutierrezdev))
- [tagurl](https://github.com/emiliano-go/tagurl): Accepts a natural language query and returns ranked semantic tags and an SEO-friendly URL slug as structured JSON. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [tokenizesentences](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/tokenizesentences): Dependency-free Python tokenizer for splitting English text into sentences and locating sentence spans. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
- [xmlstreamer](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/xmlstreamer): Stream large XML feeds with bounded memory, decompression, encoding detection and explicit handling of partial failures. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
- [xmlstreamer-ng](https://github.com/emiliano-go/xmlstreamer-ng): Fault-isolating XML feed streamer with a Rust engine: per-item streaming plus columnar, parallel, memory-bounded Arrow ingestion. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [xmlstreamer-poc](https://github.com/emiliano-go/xmlstreamer-poc): Python library that parses XML data from HTTP, HTTPS or FTP sources without loading the entire file into memory. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))

### Developer Tools

- [ClickVault](https://clickvault.emiliano-go.com/): HashiCorp Vault database secrets engine plugin for ClickHouse. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [DBWarden](https://dbwarden.org/): Declarative database migration system for Python/SQLAlchemy projects: your models are the source code, SQL is the output. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [Enodia](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/enodia): Wardriving on foot, without GPS or internet. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
- [FastAPI Boilerplate](https://github.com/benavlabs/FastAPI-boilerplate): Async FastAPI application foundation with authentication, CRUD, background jobs, caching and PostgreSQL. ([@igorbenav](https://github.com/igorbenav))
- [hestia](https://github.com/emiliano-go/hestia): Self-hostable agentic project cockpit with persistent Totem memory. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [hydra_in_typescript](https://github.com/netaru3/hydra_in_typescript): is a typescript version of hydra.
- [Keel](https://keel-linux.github.io/): Library and CLI for declarative Keel Linux appliances, compatible with TurnKey Linux appliances.
- [laya-coding-decisions](https://github.com/emiliano-go/laya-coding-decisions): Training data and harness to turn Laya into a coding-agent judge for the hestia decision engine. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [opencode-bgj](https://github.com/emiliano-go/opencode-bgj): Standalone MCP server that gives the opencode agent tools to launch and supervise long-running shell jobs in the background. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [Panopticon](https://github.com/emiliano-go/panopticon): Read-only unified index of repositories, Git history, releases, packages and CI metadata, exposed as a REST API, MCP server and dashboard. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [RBG-Harness](https://github.com/emiliano-go/RBG-Harness): Single-LLM control plane for coding agents with deterministic retrieval, verification and small learned models. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [scripts](https://github.com/LibreCourseUY/scripts): A collection of community-contributed utility scripts, organized by programming language.
- [starship-p10k-rainbow](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/starship-p10k-rainbow): Starship prompt preset that recreates the Powerlevel10k rainbow style across supported shells. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
- [tornet](https://github.com/netaru3/tornet): is hydra whit rotation ip for each N petitions.
- [Totem](https://github.com/emiliano-go/totem): Persistent memory layer for engineering agents. MCP server + CLI. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [TrustSight](https://trustsight.org/): AUR package update vetting tool. Run it before yay -Syu. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [TrustSight Harness](https://github.com/emiliano-go/trustsight-harness): Reproducible, cost-tracked adversarial measurement harness for TrustSight. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [TrustSight Lab](https://github.com/emiliano-go/trustsight-lab): Offline ML tooling to find, rank and validate deterministic TrustSight rule improvements. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))

### Data & Analytics

- [ArgosUY](https://github.com/LibreCourseUY/ArgosUY): Open-source platform that indexes Uruguay's GitHub ecosystem and exposes it through a FastAPI backend.
- [autoimmune-disorder-prediction](https://github.com/emiliano-go/autoimmune-disorder-prediction): Machine-learning exploration of the All Autoimmune Disorder 10k dataset: data download and cleaning package plus EDA and feature-engineering notebooks. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [carpricepredictor](https://github.com/emiliano-go/carpricepredictor): Predict car prices from the classic Automobile Data Set: linear-regression pipeline, FastAPI service and containerized frontend. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [crxml](https://crxml.emiliano-go.com/): High-performance Crystal Reports XML parser built on the rypipe columnar ingestion engine. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))
- [measurevolume](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/measurevolume): Estimate market-taker activity from cryptocurrency order-book snapshots by measuring visible depth depletion. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))

### Games

- [ClaudIA-CS1.6](https://github.com/NicolasBentancur/ClaudIA-CS1.6): Counter-Strike 1.6 plugin with AI chat, accounts, economy, jobs, casino games, chess and voice radio. ([@NicolasBentancur](https://github.com/NicolasBentancur))

### Security

- [FirmaUY](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/firmauy): Sign and verify PDF, XML and arbitrary files locally with the Uruguayan electronic identity card. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
- [firmauy-mcp-inspect](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/firmauy-mcp-inspect): Read-only MCP server for offline inspection of Uruguayan digital signatures with FirmaUY. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))

### Automation

- [ClaudIA](https://github.com/gauchitodev/ClaudIA): WhatsApp bot for Uruguayan groups with AI conversation, games, economy, moderation, memory and autonomous interactions. ([@gauchitodev](https://github.com/gauchitodev))

- [interferon](https://github.com/emiliano-go/interferon): Immune-inspired signaling for Docker stacks: containers broadcast typed failure and recovery signals so the fleet can respond like neighboring cells. ([@emiliano-go](https://github.com/emiliano-go))

- [wifireconnect](https://github.com/carlosplanchon/wifireconnect): Linux network watchdog that diagnoses connectivity failures and recovers Wi-Fi connections through iwd. ([@carlosplanchon](https://github.com/carlosplanchon))
